cases.name: as of one second before T0
cases.reasoning: Nothing held; retractions listed as such.

cases.name: as of T0
cases.reasoning: seq 1 held and standing, seq 2 not yet recorded.

cases.name: as of T1
cases.reasoning: seq 2 held and supersedes seq 1; the T2 retraction of seq 1 is later than the supersession, so seq 1 keeps the earliest reason.

cases.name: as of T2
cases.reasoning: seq 2 held and supersedes seq 1; the T2 retraction of seq 1 is later than the supersession, so seq 1 keeps the earliest reason.

cases.reasoning: Transaction axis picks the standing line (seq 1), then its bound kinds decide at 1987-07-01.

cases.name: both axes: valid 1987-07-01, as of T1
cases.reasoning: Transaction axis picks the standing line (seq 2), then its bound kinds decide at 1987-07-01.
